def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def mode(values):
        counts = Counter(values)
        return max(counts, key=counts.get)

    row_modes = [mode(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [mode(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]

    # The separator color is the modal color occurring on the fewest rows
    # and columns; the tile interiors have the other, more common modal color.
    candidates = set(row_modes) & set(col_modes)
    line_color = min(
        candidates,
        key=lambda color: row_modes.count(color) + col_modes.count(color)
    )

    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == line_color]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == line_color]

    interior = [
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in cols
    ]
    fill = mode(interior)

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            )
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                out_row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                out_row.append(fill)
        out.append(out_row)

    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def mode(values):
        return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_modes = [mode(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [mode(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]

    common = set(row_modes) & set(col_modes)
    line_color = min(
        common,
        key=lambda color: row_modes.count(color) + col_modes.count(color)
    )

    # Keep grid lines that have colored intersection markers; this excludes
    # any plain outer margin that happens to have the line color.
    rows = [
        r for r in range(h)
        if row_modes[r] == line_color
        and any(grid[r][c] != line_color for c in range(w))
    ]
    cols = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if col_modes[c] == line_color
        and any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in range(h))
    ]

    interior = [
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h) if r not in rows
        for c in range(w) if c not in cols
    ]
    fill = mode(interior)

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            )
            out_row.append(
                corners[0] if corners[0] != line_color
                and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners)
                else fill
            )
        out.append(out_row)

    return out
